hypothesis: Add Adoption Friction Inversion (Phase 0) — engineer systems easier to use than skip
aspect: Adoption resilience — preventing system abandonment after initial rollout
benchmark_task: Design operational systems for Authority Flywheel that the team actually uses after week 2
changes: Added Phase 0: Adoption Friction Inversion with 4 sub-steps (Bypass Inventory, Friction Inversion Design, Early Win Engineering, Decay Detection Triggers)
